title: Leia Seeker
caption: Leia Seeker (V)
lore: Military version of a 'remote.' Programmed to stalk specific targets or secondary targets. Heat and light sensors track with fatal accuracy. Can stow away on starships.
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with {permanent-weapon} Leia or a senator, this weapon and that character are lost (“all cards” situation).
